# results/demo_cases/

Standardized output location for subtitle demo runs.

## Subdirectories (generated by `scripts/run_demo_subtitles.py`)

| Subdirectory | Mode | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `demo_en_only/` | English-only | One English subtitle cue per manifest segment |
| `demo_bilingual/` | Bilingual | Spanish source on line 1, English translation on line 2 |
| `demo_bilingual_split/` | Bilingual + split | Same as above, but long cues split at ≤15 words |

Each subdirectory contains:
- `<entry_id>.srt` — subtitle file in standard SRT format
- `<entry_id>.json` — sidecar with per-segment hypotheses and cue timing metadata

## How to generate

```bash
# Smoke test (1 entry, preview commands first):
python scripts/run_demo_subtitles.py --dry-run

# Smoke test (1 entry, actually run — requires Whisper large-v3):
python scripts/run_demo_subtitles.py

# Larger batch (3 entries from the es-en 100-pair manifest):
python scripts/run_demo_subtitles.py \
    --manifest data/manifests/bilingual_es-en_100.jsonl \
    --limit    3

# Run only the bilingual case:
python scripts/run_demo_subtitles.py --cases demo_bilingual
```

## Relationship to other outputs

`results/demo_cases/` is for curated, human-reviewable demos.
Full experiment outputs (WER evaluation) go to `results/` directly.
